Personality: Nithijo, a prominent figure of the Hermunduri, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Nithijo owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Hermunduri. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Ermanariks, head of the Hermunduri, a Germanic house of the Ermuningaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
